title: Initiative Retrospective Clock and SLI Priority Map
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable rhythm ('Retrospective Clock') and accompanying SLI Priority Map to ensure initiative owners can correlate error-budget burn to prioritization decisions across quarters.

Why: We have many reliability initiatives and inconsistent postmortem/retrospective cadences. That creates ambiguity about which initiatives should consume error budget, when to throttle rollouts, and how to sequence follow-up work. The SLI Priority Map will be a living artifact mapping SLIs -> current targets -> normalized priority score to drive cross-team trade-offs.

Scope:
- Define a 6-step Retrospective Clock (Daily signal gating -> Weekly heatmap -> Bi-weekly initiative sync -> Monthly retro -> Quarterly reset/commitments -> Auto-throttle rule updates).
- Design the SLI Priority Map schema (SLI id, owner, target, current burn rate, normalized priority score, linked initiative(s), suggested action).
- Implement a lightweight dashboard widget in Console that surfaces the map and the next clock milestone.
- Create runbook entries for triggering canary throttles when burn-rate thresholds are met.

Out of scope for this ticket: full enforcement automation and RBAC rollout (separate Dedicated/Private compliance work).

Trade-offs discussed:
- Granularity vs noise: we decided on grouped SLIs (per-product/route) rather than per-route to avoid alert fatigue.
- Manual curation vs heuristics: early rollout will be curator-driven with heuristics suggested by runtime telemetry (follow-up ticket to improve heuristics).

Success criteria (high level):
- Initiative owners can see prioritized SLI list and current burn rates in Console.
- 80% of initiatives reference the SLI Priority Map in their quarterly commitments.
- Weekly heatmap and monthly retrospective cadence adopted by Reliability Guild and 3 pilot product teams.

Links to artifacts:
- Confluence PRD (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Reliability/Retrospective+Clock+PRD
- Design mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abc-RetClockMocks
